- info src/jbus/dispatch.py:163 `proven` grandfathers any brief with no `Proves it:` line, so a brief written after this change can leave the line out and launch ungated: the exemption is not tied to rows approved before (question 24 holds the choice)

- info src/jbus/dispatch.py:332 a brief that fails both `designed` and `proven` gets the design gate first and the proof gate only after a fix and a new approval: two rounds of the user's approval where one gate with both reasons would do
- info src/jbriefs/parse.py:167 `Brief.proof` has no caller in src/, only the tests read it (both reviewers)
